scope: Finite explicit-state graph of deterministic atomic actions; environment chooses action order. Synthetic development, not LLMLang semantics.
state: Fixed named integer fields with per-family bounds; heap graph edges encoded as masks; protocol and component states explicit.
transition: Total action relation: disabled actions are stuttering with a rejected/no-op observation; actions and observations are named.
exploration: Breadth-first reachable state graph to declared depth, checking every outgoing edge from each state reachable before depth bound. State merging is valid only for Markovian edge/state properties; path-dependent obligations require state augmentation.
unsupported: Unknown family, malformed state, invalid action/observation, exceeded bound or resource cap fails without proof verdict.
